title: Gaultheria procumbens essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Gaultheria procumbens essential oil is derived from the wintergreen plant, known for its strong, camphor-like aroma. This essential oil is commonly used in herbalism for its stimulating and warming properties. It is often applied topically to alleviate pain and improve circulation, particularly in conditions like arthritis or muscle aches. The oil is also used in aromatherapy to enhance mental clarity and reduce stress. Due to its potency, it is typically diluted before use to avoid skin irritation.
